proof.cap: R-575 full-state |F_r|<=B and mobility<=1 give C=exp(beta B), uniform only in r.
proof.labelled_realization: M=4(v+e) independent per-label proposal rate C, acceptance c_a/C on valid roots and zero on invalid roots. MC(P-I)=L_r exactly; no source dynamics is changed.
proof.W_jump: Only LK changes instantaneous W; each signed LK move affects at most two faces, hence |Delta W|<=d_r=4*pi/(p*K_r). Other roots still affect subsequent rates.
proof.LK_proposal_count: N_LK^prop(S) is Poisson with mean Lambda*S, Lambda=2*e*C. Its second moment is Lambda*S+(Lambda*S)^2. Accepted LK events are not assumed Poisson.
proof.path_containment: Every inverse clock sample is in [0,S], simultaneously for all vertices, so there is no vertex union factor or random-semigroup substitution.
proof.limit: K_r>=2^(r+1) tends to infinity; all other constants fixed. Thus the maximal squared-displacement expectation is O(K_r^(-2)) and tends to zero.
proof.independent: Finite count augmentation stopped at m has count and square generators 1_(n<m)lambda_r(x) and 1_(n<m)(2n+1)lambda_r(x). Integrate, bound intensity by Lambda, then monotone m->infinity; same second-moment inequality.
proof.additional_crosscheck: Original external-time stationary per-label Gibbs flux<=1 gives expected W variation<=2*e*d_r*S. Since W in [-1,1], E_r(T)<=4*e*d_r*S->0 independently, without changed-clock stationarity.
proof.static_nontriviality: R-575 original initial Gibbs Var(W)>=exp(-2 beta B)/(2p)>0 remains separate and unchanged; no local-clock stationary law is inferred.
